segments.name: Commercial Real Estate Management
segments.description: Acquires, leases and manages commercial real estate properties generating rental revenue under lease agreements with commercial clients.
segments.evidence: beginning in 2024, we have been acquiring, leasing and managing commercial real estate properties that generate rental revenue under lease agreements with our commercial clients.

revenueModel.text: Commercial clients pay monthly rent and certain property operating expenses under long-term net lease agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: A net lease typically requires the client to be responsible for monthly rent and certain property operating expenses including property taxes, insurance, and maintenance.

changes.text: In 2023, the company discontinued its pet food manufacturing business segment due to operational challenges.
changes.evidence: we decided to discontinue our petfood manufacturing business segment in the first quarter of 2023 due to the above operational challenges.

changes.text: In 2024, the company discontinued its restaurant business segment.
changes.evidence: We discontinued our restaurant business segment during the second quarter of 2024.

changes.text: In 2025, BVBA was fully disposed of as the bankruptcy liquidation was completed.
changes.evidence: On May 6, 2025, the Court announced that the bankruptcy liquidation of BVBA had been completed and the bankruptcy proceedings were completed.
